resources.description: ac-2: Account Management - The organization shall manage system accounts including creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal of accounts with appropriate authorization.
ac-3: Access Enforcement - The information system shall enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources based on applicable access control policies.

ac-6: Least Privilege - The organization shall employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized access for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) which are necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.

au-2: Audit Events - The information system shall generate audit records for system events, configuration changes, security-relevant events including authentication attempts, and access control decisions.

au-6: Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting - The organization shall review and analyze information system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity, investigate suspicious activity or suspected violations, and report ...

au-12: Audit Generation - The information system shall provide audit record generation capability for auditable events and allow authorized personnel to select which auditable events are to be audited by specific components.

cm-2: Baseline Configuration - The organization shall develop, document, and maintain baseline configurations for information systems including software components, dependencies, and security configurations.

ia-5: Authenticator Management - The organization shall manage information system authenticators including initial authenticator distribution, establishing minimum authenticator strength requirements, and protecting authenticator ...

sc-28: Protection of Information at Rest - The information system shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information at rest including credentials, configuration files, and assessment data.

si-2: Flaw Remediation - The organization shall identify, report, and correct information system flaws through systematic flaw remediation processes including security vulnerability scanning and patch management.

si-3: Malicious Code Protection - The organization shall implement malicious code protection mechanisms including scanning downloaded software, configuration files, and dependencies from external sources.

si-4: Information System Monitoring - The organization shall monitor information systems to detect attacks, unauthorized access attempts, and indicators of potential attacks, and identify unauthorized use of the system.

si-7: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity - The information system shall employ integrity verification tools and techniques to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information including component validation, dependency veri...

si-10: Information Input Validation - The information system shall check the validity of user inputs including command arguments, configuration files, and structured documents to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.

sa-3: System Development Life Cycle - The organization shall manage information systems using a system development life cycle that incorporates information security considerations throughout all phases.

sa-10: Developer Configuration Management - The organization shall require developers to perform configuration management during system development, including tracking security flaws and flaw resolution, and managing component dependencies.

sa-11: Developer Security Testing and Evaluation - The organization shall require developers to create and implement security test and evaluation plans including static analysis, dynamic analysis, and security validation testing.
